header.note: integers x scale = metres; x east, y north, local TM centred on P0 (origin.json). Rings flat [x0,y0,...] no closing vertex, exterior CCW, holes CW. Sea/river = absence of land.
source: OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL): natural=coastline (land polygons, built by polygonising coastline inside the box), parks/landcover, inland water, road network, highways/bridges
NYC Open Data PLUTO (64uk-42ks): lot floors / building area -> block average height and coverage (NYC only)
header.blocks_note: blocks = land minus OSM streets buffered to typical right-of-way widths (motorway 30 m, trunk 30 m, primary 30 m, secondary 26 m, tertiary 22 m, residential 18 m, unclassified 15 m, living_street 12 m, pedestrian 10 m) minus inland water; simplified 0.5 m; parks are included as blocks (see park_pct). Height = footprint-weighted mean of PLUTO lots inside the block, h = 3.341*floors + 2.153 m (fit vs NYC footprint heights in the UES). -1 = no data (New Jersey, or no buildings).

schema.blocks: [h_mean, [coverage_pct, park_pct, h_max], polygon]  h in 0.1 m units, -1 = unknown
schema.water: inland water polygons (OSM natural=water) clipped to land, simplified 2 m
schema.highways: [class, bridge(1)/tunnel(-1)/0, name_index, line] motorway/trunk + primary/secondary bridges, simplified 2 m
